instruction: Please adjust the reply position setting so that my responses appear above the quoted text in emails.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the reply position setting in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks that mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top is set to 1 (reply on top) and ensures it's not set to 0 (reply below). This matches the actual preference key used in this Thunderbird profile. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same application, single configuration change with verification

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks 'mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top' preference key which matches the Thunderbird profile being used
Expected value of 1 correctly represents 'reply on top' setting as required by the instruction
Unexpect rule correctly ensures the setting is not 0 (reply below), preventing false positives from partial completion
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window to ensure preferences are written to prefs.js before verification
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly extracts prefs.js from VM to local cache for metric analysis
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses Thunderbird preference format and validates both expect and unexpect rules
Complete coverage of instruction requirements - single setting change is fully verified
Static type warning about Union return type is not a semantic issue - metric correctly handles both string path and None cases

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
